al-Fīrūzābādī, Muḥammad b. Yaʻqūb 1346. Sufar al-saʻāda (al-Qāhira: Idāra al-Ṭibāʻa al-Munīra, 1346).

al-Anṣārī, Abū Yaḥyā Zakariyyā’ and Muṣṭafā al-Ḏahabī 1332. Fatḥ (3) al-wahhāb bi-šarḥ Manhaǧ al-ṭullāb li-šayḫ al-islām Abī Yaḥyā Zakariyyā’ al-Anṣārī wa-bi-hāmišihi matn al-Manhaǧ al-maḏkūr li-šayḫ al-islām Abī Yaḥyā Zakariyyā’ al-Anṣārī wa-li-tamām al-nafʻ wuḍiʻa bi-hāmišihi ayḍan maʻa al-matn al-maḏkūr ḥawāšī ... al-Sayyid Muṣṭafā al-Ḏahabī al-Šāfiʻī al-musammā bi-al-Rasā’l al-ḏahabiyya fī al-masā’il al-daqīqa al-manhaǧiyya (Miṣr: Dār al-Kutub al-ʻArabiyya al-Kubrā, 1332).

Muḥammad b. Aḥmad al-Širbīnī and Sulaymān b. Muḥammad al-Baǧīramī 1329. Ḥāšiyat ḫātimat al-muhaqqiqīn ... al-Šayḫ Sulaymān al-Baǧīramī al-musammā bi-Tuḥfat al-ḥabīb ʻalā šarḥ al-Ḫaṭīb al-musammā bi-al-Iqnāʻ fī ḥall alfāẓ Abī Šuǧāʻ wa-bi-hāmišihā al-šarḥ al-maḏkūr (Miṣr: Dār al-Kutub al-ʻArabiyya al-Kubrā, 1329).

ʻAbd Allāh b. Muḥammad b. Aḥmad al-Fākihī 1351. Kašf al-niqāb šarḥ al-imām al-fāḍil ʻAbd Allāh b. Muḥammad b. Aḥmad al-Fākihī ʻan muḫaddarāt mulḥat al-iʻrāb li-al-ustāḏ ... Abī Muḥammad al-Qāsim b. ʻAlī al-Ḥarīrī al-Baṣrī bi-asfal al-ṣaḥā’if taqrīrāt li-afāḍil al-ʻulamā’ (Miṣr: Maṭbaʻat Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa-Awlāduhu, 1351).

Abū al-ʻAbbās Sayyidī Aḥmad b. al-Šams 1331. Hāḏa al-ta’līf al-musammā bi-al-Daʻā’im al-qur’āniyya al-aṯariyya li-al-ṭarīq al-šarʻiyya al-ḥaqqiyya li-Šayḫinā ... Abī al-ʻAbbās Sayyidī Aḥmad b. al-Šams wa-bi-hāmišihi al-šarḥ al-musammā Barīd ahl al-taǧrīd ʻalā Taḏkarat al-murīd kilāhumā li-al-Šayḫ ... Šayḫinā Abī al-ʻAbbās Sayyidī Aḥmad b. al-Šams (Makka: Matbaʻat al-taraqqī al-māǧdiyya al-ʻuṯmāniyya, 1331).

al-Zabīdī, Abū al-ʻAbbās Aḥmad b. Aḥmad, al-Šarqāwī, ʻAbd Allāh b. Ḥiǧāzī, and Ibn Qāsim al-Ġazzī, Šams al-Dīn Abū ʻAbd Allāh Muḥammad s.a. al-Taǧrīd al-ṣarīḥ li-aḥādīṯ al-ǧāmiʻ al-ṣaḥīḥ ... wa-bi-al-hāmiš ḥawāš min šarḥay al-Šayḫ al-Šarqāwī wa-al-imām Ibn Qāsim al-Ġazzī (Maktabat Ibn Salam, s.a.).
Ǧawhar b. Ḥaydar b. ʻAlī 1348. al-Bidʻa al-saniyya ʻalā al-lumʻa al-bahiyya (Miṣr: Maṭbaʻat al-Maʻāhid, 1348).
Ḫayr al-Dīn al-Ziriklī 1986. al-Aʻlām: qāmūs tarāǧim, vol. 7, Muḥammad - Nāfiʻ (Beirut: Dār al-ʻilm lil-malāyīn, 1986).

al-Anṣārī, Abū Yaḥyā Zakariyyā’ and Muṣṭafā al-Ḏahabī s.a. Fatḥ (4) al-wahhāb bi-šarḥ Manhaǧ al-ṭullāb li-Šayḫ al-islām Abī Yaḥyā Zakariyyā’ al-Anṣārī wa-bi-hāmišihi matn al-Manhaǧ al-maḏkūr li-Šayḫ al-islām Abī Yaḥyā Zakariyyā’ al-Anṣārī wa-li-tamām al-nafʻ wuḍiʻa bi-hāmišihi ayḍan maʻa al-matn al-maḏkūr ḥawāšī [...] al-Sayyid Muṣṭafā al-Ḏahabī ... al-musammā bi-al-Rasā’il al-ḏahabiyya fī al-masā’il al-daqīqa al-manhaǧiyya (Sinqāfūra (Singapore): Maktabat wa-Maṭbaʻat Sulaymān Marʻī, s.a.).
al-Ṣabbān, ʻAlī b. Muḥammad 1887. Ḥāšiyat al-Ṣabbān ʻalā šarḥ al-Ušmūnī ʻalā Alfiyyat Ibn Mālik fī al-naḥw (al-Maṭbaʻa al-Ḫayriyya, 1887).

al-Šarqāwī, ʻAbd Allāh b. Ḥiǧāzī, Zakariyyā’ al-Anṣārī, Abū Yaḥyā, and Muṣṭafā b. Ḥanafī al-Ḏahabī 1360. Ḥāšiyat al-Šayḫ ʻAbd Allāh b. Ḥiǧāzī b. Ibrāhīm al-Šāfiʻī al-Azharī al-šahīr bi-al-Šarqāwī ʻalā Tuḥfat al-tullāb bi-šarḥ Taḥrīr tanqīḥ al-lubāb ... wa-bi-al-hāmiš (1) Tuḥfat al-ṭullāb ... (2) Taqrīr al-Sayyid Muṣṭafā b. Ḥanafī al-Ḏahabī al-Miṣrī ʻalā Ḥāšiyat al-Šayḫ al-Šarqāwī, ed. Aḥmad Saʻd ʻAlī (Miṣr: Šarikat maktabat wa-maṭbaʻat Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa-Awlādihi, 1360).

al-Šaʻrānī, ʻAbd al-Wahhāb b. Aḥmad and Muḥammad b. ʻAbd al-Raḥmān al-Dimašqī al-ʻUṯmānī al-Šāfiʻī 1359. al-Mīzān al-kubrā ... wa-bi-hāmišihi Raḥmat al-umma fī iḫtilāf al-a’imma, ed. Aḥmad Saʻd ʻAlī (Mṣr: Šarikat maktabat wa-maṭbaʻat Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa-Awlādihi, 1359).

al-Nawāwī, Muḥammad b. ʻUmar b. ʻArabī al-Ǧāwī and al-Wāḥidī, ʻAlī b. Aḥmad s.a. Marāḥ labīd - Tafsīr al-Nawawī al-Tafsīr al-munīr li-maʻālim al-tanzīl al-musfir ʻan wuǧūh maḥāsin al-ta’wīl al-musammā ṭibqan li-maʻnāhu Marāḥ labīd li-kašf maʻnā Qur’ān maǧīd li-ǧāmiʻihi ... Muḥammad Nawawī al-Ǧāwī ... wa-bi-hāmišihi Kitāb al-waǧīz fī tafsīr al-Qur’ān al-ʻazīz li-al-imām Abī al-Ḥasan ʻAlī b. Aḥmad al-Wāḥidī (Sinqāfūra (Singapore): Maktabat wa-Maṭbaʻat Sulaymān Marʻī, s.a.).

al-Šaʻrānī, ʻAbd al-Wahhāb b. Aḥmad 1373. al-Ṭabaqāt al-kubrā al-musammā bi-Lawāqiʻ al-anwār fī ṭabaqāt al-aḫyār ... wa-bi-al-hāmiš al-Anwār al-qudsiyya fī bayān ādāb al-ʻubūdiyya li-al-mu’allif (Miṣr: Šarikat maktabat wa-maṭbaʻat Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa-Awlādihi, 1373).

al-Qušayrī, Abū al-Qāsim and Zakariyyā al-Anṣārī, Abū Yaḥyā 1359. al-Risāla al-qušayriyya ... wa-bi-al-hāmiš muntaḫabāt min šarḥ Abī Yaḥyā Zakariyyā al-Anṣārī, ed. Aḥmad Saʻd ʻAlī (al-Qāhira: al-Ḥalabī, 1359).

al-Šiǧāʻī, Aḥmad and Maḫlūf, Muḥammad Ḥasanayn al-ʻAdawī al-Mālikī 1356. al-Ḥāšiya al-ṯāniya ... ʻalā al-Ǧawāhir al-muntaẓimāt fī ʻuqūd al-maqūlāt wa-huwa šarḥ naẓm al-Maqūlāt al-ʻašar kilāhumā li-al-ʻallama al-Šayḫ Aḥmad al-Šiǧāʻī, ed. Aḥmad Saʻd ʻAlī (Miṣr: Maṭbaʻat Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa-Awlāduhu, 1356).

al-Damanhūrī, Muḥammad and al-Ḫawāṣṣ, Aḥmad b. ʻAbbās al-Qinā’ī 1354. al-Muḫtaṣar al-šāfī ʻalā matn al-Kāfī ... wa-bi-hāmišihi al-Kāfī fi ʻilmay al-ʻarūḍ wa-al-qawāfī (Miṣr: Maṭbaʻat Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa-Awlāduhu, 1354).

Zakariyyā’ al-Anṣārī, Abū Yaḥyā and Yūsuf b. Sālim al-Ḥifnāwī 1351. Šarḥ ... Abī Yahyā Zakariyyā’ al-Anṣārī al-musammā al-Maṭlaʻ ʻalā matn Īsāġūǧī fī al-manṭiq wa-ʻalayhi ḥawāšī šarīfa wa-taʻlīqāt munīfa li-al-Šayḫ Yūsuf al-Ḥifnāwī al-maʻrūf bi-al-Ḥifnī (Miṣr: Šarikat Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa-Awlāduhu, 1351).
Ḫayr al-Dīn al-Ziriklī 1986. al-Aʻlām: qāmūs tarāǧim, vol. 4, ʻAbd al-Salām - ʻAlī (Beirut: Dār al-ʻilm lil-malāyīn, 1986).

al-Baqarī, Muḥammad b. ʻUmar and Sibṭ al-Māridīnī, Muḥammad b. Muḥammad s.a. Ḥāšiyat al-ʻallāma ... Muḥammad b. ʻUmar al-Baqarī al-Šāfiʻī ʻalā Šarḥ matn al-Raḥbiyya fī ʻilm al-farā’iḍ li-al-imām al-šahīr bi-Sibṭ al-Māridīnī ... wa-bi-hāmišihi al-šarḥ al-maḏkūr (Miṣr: Maṭbaʻat Dār iḥyā’ al-kutub al-ʻarabiyya li-aṣḥābihā ʻĪsā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa-Šurakā’ihi, s.a.).
Daḥlān, Aḥmad b. Zaynī 1965. Taqrīb al-uṣūl li-tashīl al-wuṣūl li-maʻrifat Allāh wa-al-rasūl (Miṣr: Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī, 1965).

Naṣr Ibn Muḥammad Abū al-Layṯ al-Samarqandī 1962. Le traite arabe ‘Muqaddima’ d’Abou-l-Laiṯ as-Samarqandī en version mamelouk-kiptchak (Ms. Istanbul, Aya Sofya 1451), ed. Ananiasz Zajączkowski (Warszawa: Państwowe Wydawnictwo Naukowe, 1962).
al-Ġazzālī, Abū Ḥāmid Muḥammad b. Muḥammad 1380. al-Maḥabba wa-al-šawq wa-al-uns wa-al-riḍā (Miṣr: Šarikat maktabat wa-maṭbaʻat Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa-Awlādihi, 1380).

al-Maqqarī, Aḥmad, al-Dāh al-Šinqīṭī, Muḥammad b. Aḥmad, and Ibn Fāris, Aḥmad b. Fāris b. Zakariyyā’ 1371. Iḍā’at al-duǧunna fī iʻtiqād Ahl al-Sunna ... wa-li-tamām al-nafʻ waḍaʻnā ʻalayhi Šarḥ al-šayḥ Muḥammad b. Aḥmad al-mulaqqab bi-al-Dāh al-Šinqīṭī wa-yalīhi Awǧaz al-sayr li-ḫayr al-bašar li-Ibn Fāris, ed. Abū al-Faḍl ʻAbd Allāh Muḥammad al-Ṣiddīq al-Ġamārī (Bayrūt: Dār al-ʻIlm al-Ǧamīʻ, 1371).

al-Lamṭī, Aḥmad b. Mubārak and al-Šaʻrānī, ʻAbd al-Wahhāb 1345. al-Ibrīz allaḏī talaqqāhu naǧm al-ʻirfān al-ḥāfiẓ Sayyidī Aḥmad b. al-Mubārak ʻan Quṭb al-wāṣilīn Sayyidī ʻAbd al-ʻAzīz al-Dabbāġ ... wa-bi-hāmišihi kitābān ǧalīlān awwaluhumā kitāb Durar al-ġawwāṣ ʻalā fatāwī Sayyidī ʻAlī al-Ḫawwāṣ wa-ṯānīhimā kitāb al-Ǧawāhir wa-al-durar ... wa-kilāhumā li-al-quṭb ... Sayyidī ʻAbd al-Wahhāb al-Šaʻrānī (Miṣr: al-Maṭbaʻa al-Azhariyya, 1345).

Ibn Ḥaǧar al-Haytamī, Aḥmad b. Muḥammad and Muḥammad b. Sālim al-Ḥifnāwī 1323. Šarḥ al-imām Šihāb al-Dīn Aḥmad b. Ḥaǧar al-Haytamī ʻalā matn al-hamziyya fī madḥ ḫayr al-barriyya ... wa-bi-hāmišihi Ḥāšiya li-Šayḫ al-islām ... Sayyidī Muḥammad al-Ḥifnī (Miṣr: al-Maṭbaʻa al-maymaniyya, 1323).
Ibn ʻAẓẓūm al-Qayrawānī 1317. Kitāb al-Ṣalāt al-Zakiyya ʻalā Nabiyynā Ḫayr al-Barriyya (Makka: al-Maṭbaʻa al-Mīriyya, 1317).

al-Fākihī, ʻAbd Allāh b. Aḥmad and al-Ḥaṭṭāb, Muḥammad b. Muḥammad 1351. al-Fawākih al-ǧaniyya ʻalā mutammimat al-Āǧurrūmiyya ... bi-hāmišihā Mutammimat al-Aǧurrūmiyya (Cairo: Dār Iḥyā’ al-Kutub al-ʻArabiyya, 1351).

Ḥasan al-ʻAdawī al-Ḥamzāwī 2010. Bulūġ al-masarrāt : šarḥ Dalā’il al-ḫayrāt wa-šawāriq al-anwār fī ḏikr al-ṣalāt ʻalā al-nabī al-muḫtār, ed. Aḥmad b. Farīd b. Aḥmad Mazīdī (al-Qāhira: Dār al-Āfāq al-ʻArabiyya, 2010).
Ḫayr al-Dīn al-Ziriklī 1986. al-Aʻlām: qāmus tarāǧim, vol. 1, al-Ābarī - Iġnāṭiyūs (Beirut: Dār al-ʻilm lil-malāyīn, 1986).

al-Bāǧūrī, Ibrāhīm, Ibn Qāsim Muḥammad al-Ġazzī, and Abū Šuǧāʻ al-Iṣfahānī 1925. Ḥāšiyyat al-ʻAllāma al-Fāḍil wa-al-Qudwa (3) al-Kāmil al-Šayḫ Ibrāhīm al-Bāǧūrī ʻalā Šarḥ al-ʻAllāma Ibn Qāsim al-Ġazzī ʻalā Matn al-Šāyḫ Abī Šuǧāʻ fī Maḏhab al-Imām al-Šāfiʻī (Cairo: al-Maṭbaʻā al-Maymaniyya, 1925).

al-Nabahānī, Yūsuf b. Ismāʻīl and ʻAbd Allāh b. Asʻad al-Yāfiʻī 1329. Ǧāmiʻ karāmāt al-awliyā’ ... wa-yalīhi kitāb Asbāb al-ta’līf ... wa-tatmīman li-al-fawā’id waḍaʻnā bi-al-hāmiš baqiyyat al-kitāb al-ǧalīl al-musammā Našr al-maḥāsin al-ġāliya fī faḍl mašā’iḫ al-ṣūfiyya (Miṣr: Dār al-Kutub al-ʻArabiyya al-Kubrā, 1329).
al-Tirmiḏī, Muḥammad b. ʻĪsā 1985. al-Šamā’il al-muḥammadiyya, ed. ʻIzzat ʻUbayd al-Daʻʻās (Bayrūt: Dār al-Ḥadīṯ, 1985).

al-Munāwī, ʻAbd al-Ra’ūf and al-Qārī al-Harawī, ʻAlī b. Sulṭān Muḥammad 1318. Ǧamʻ al-wasā’il fī šarḥ al-Šamā’il ... wa-bi-hāmišihi baqiyyat šarḥ al-imām al-muḥaddiṯ al-šayḫ ʻAbd al-Ra’ūf al-Munāwī al-Miṣrī (Miṣr: al-Maṭbaʻa al-ʻĀmira al-Šarafiyya, 1318).

Aḥmad b. Zaynī Daḥlān and Nūr al-Dīn al-Ḥalabī, ʻAlī b. Ibrāhīm 1329. Insān al-ʻuyūn fī sīrat al-amīn al-ma’mūn al-maʻrūfa bi-al-Sīra al-Ḥalabiyya ta’līf ... ʻAlī b. Burhān al-Dīn al-Ḥalabī al-Šāfiʻī ... wa-bi-hāmišihā al-Sīra al-nabawiyya wa-al-āṯār al-muḥammadiyya li-muftī ... Aḥmad Zaynī al-mašhūr bi-Daḥlān (Miṣr: al-Maṭbaʻa al-Azhariyya, 1329).

ʻAbd Allāh b. Aḥmad al-Fākihī and al-ʻUlaymī, Yāsīn b. Zayn al-Dīn 1347. Ḥāšiyat al-ʻallāma al-Šayḫ Yāsīn ʻalā šarḥ al-Fākihī ʻalā Qaṭr al-nadā, ed. Muḥammad Kāmil b. Muḥammad al-Asyūṭī al-Azharī (Miṣr: Maṭbaʻat al-Taqaddum al-ʻIlmiyya, 1347).
al-Qur’ān al-karīm (2) S. A. ([India?]: S. A.).

ʻAbd al-Munʻim ʻIwaḍ al-Ǧirǧāwī and Muḥammad Quṭṭa al-ʻAdawī 1355. Šarḥ al-šayḫ ʻAbd al-Munʻim ʻIwaḍ al-Ǧirǧāwī ... ʻalā Šawāhid Ibn ʻAqīl li-Alfiyyat al-imām Ibn Mālik wa-bi-al-hāmiš Fatḥ al-ǧalīl bi-šarḥ Šawāhid Ibn ʻAqīl, ed. Aḥmad Saʻd ʻAlī (Miṣr: Maṭbaʻat Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa-awlāduhu, 1355).

al-Nawawī, Muḥyī al-Dīn Abū Zakariyyā’, Abū al-Qāsim ʻAbd al-Karīm b. Muḥammad al-Rāfiʻī, and Ibn Ḥaǧar al-ʻAsqalānī, Abū al-Faḍl Aḥmad b. ʻAlī 1344. al-Maǧmūʻ šarḥ al-Muhaḏḏab ... wa-yalīhi Fatḥ al-ʻazīz šarḥ al-Waǧīz ... wa-yalīhi al-Talḫīṣ al-ḥabīr fī taḫrīǧ aḥādīṯ al-Rāfiʻī al-kabīr (Miṣr: Maṭbaʻat al-Taḍāmun al-Aḫawī, 1344).
al-Maqqarī, Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. Yaḥyā 1374. Iḍā’at al-duǧunna fī iʻtiqād Ahl al-Sunna (al-Qāhira: Maktaba al-Qāhira, 1374).

Abū Šāma, ʻAbd al-Raḥmān b. Ismāʻīl and al-Dabbāʻ, ʻAlī b. Muḥammad 1349. Ibrāz al-maʻānī min Ḥirz al-amānī ... wa-huwa šarḥ matn al-Šāṭibiyya fī al-qirā’āt al-sabʻ ... wa-bi-hāmišihi kitābān al-awwal Iršād al-murīd ilā maqṣūd al-qaṣīd wa-huwa šarḥ ʻalā al-Šāṭibiyya ayḍan, al-ṯānī al-Bahǧa al-marḍiyya šarḥ al-Durra al-muḍiyya fī al-qirā’āt al-ṯalāṯ al-mutammima li-al-ʻašar (Miṣr: Maṭbaʻat Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa-Awlāduhu, 1349).
Ḥāšiyat Nasimāt al-asḥār ʻalā šarḥ Ifāḍat al-anwār ʻalā matn uṣūl al-manār 1328. (Cairo: Dār al-Kutub al-ʻarabiyya al-kubrā, 1328).

al-Šaʻrānī, ʻAbd al-Wahhāb b. Aḥmad b. ʻAlī and al-Fīrūzābādī, Muḥammad b. Yaʻqūb al-Šīrāzī 1370. Kašf al-ġumma ʻan ǧamīʻ al-umma wa-bi-hāmišihi al-kitāb al-musammā Sufar al-saʻāda, ed. Aḥmad Saʻd ʻAlī (al-Qāhira: Maṭbaʻat Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa-Awlāduhu, 1370).

al-Nawāwī, Muḥammad b. ʻUmar b. ʻArabī al-Ǧāwī and al-Wāḥidī, ʻAlī b. Aḥmad s.a. al-Tafsīr al-munīr li-maʻālim al-tanzīl ... al-musammā ṭibqan li-maʻnāhu Marāḥ labīd li-kašf maʻnā Qur’ān maǧīd ... wa-bi-hāmišihi kitāb al-Waǧīz fī tafsīt al-Qur’ān al-ʻazīz (Miṣr: Dār al-Kutub al-ʻArabiyya al-Kubrā, s.a.).
Ibn Ḥaǧar al-Haytami and al-Suyūṭī, ʻAbd al-Raḥmān 1325. al-Fatāwī al-ḥadīṯiyya wa-bi-hāmišihi kitāb al-Durar al-muntaṯira fī al-aḥādīṯ al-muštahira (Miṣr: al-Maṭbaʻa al-Maymaniyya, 1325).

al-Šāfiʻī, Muḥammad b. Idrīs 1358. al-Risāla li-al-imām al-Muṭṭalibī Muḥammad b. Idrīs al-Šāfiʻī, ed. Aḥmad Muḥammad Šākir (Miṣr: Šarikat Maktabat wa-Maṭbaʻat Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa-Awlāduhu, 1358).
Muṣṭafā Abū Sayf al-Ḥammāmī 1355. Taqārīẓ al-naḥḍa al-iṣlāḥīyya li-al-usra al-islāmiyya, ed. Aḥmad Saʻd ʻAlī (al-Qāhira: Maṭbaʻat Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa-Awlāduhu, 1355).

Ibn al-Azraq, Ibrāhīm b. ʻAbd al-Raḥmān and Šams al-Dīn al-Ḏahabī, Muḥammad b. Aḥmad 1367. Tashīl al-manāfiʻ fī al-ṭibb wa-al-ḥikma ... wa-bi-hāmišihi al-Ṭibb al-nabawī li-al-ḥāfiẓ Abī ʻAbd Allāh Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. ʻUṯmān al-Ḏahabī (Miṣr: Šarikat Maktabat wa-Maṭbaʻat Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa-Awlāduhu, 1367).
al-Ġazzālī, Abū Ḥāmid Muḥammad b. Muḥammad al-Ṭūsī 1909. Kitāb al-Iqtiṣād fī al-iʻtiqād (Cairo: Maṭbaʻat al-saʻāda, 1909).
Muḥammad b. Hiba al-Makkī 1327. Kitāb Ḥadā’iq al-fuṣūl wa-ǧawāhir al-ʻaqūl (S. L: 1327).
Luis Molina, ed., 1990. Estudios onomástico-biográficos de al-Andalus IV, Estudios onomástico-biográficos de al-Andalus, IV (Granada: CSIC, Escuela de Estudios Árabes, 1990).

Ibn Ḥaǧar al-Haytamī, Aḥmad b. Muḥammad and Muḥammad b. Sālim al-Ḥifnāwī 1307. Šarḥ (2) al-imām Šihāb al-Dīn Aḥmad b. Ḥaǧar al-Haytamī ʻalā matn al-hamziyya fī madḥ ḫayr al-barriyya... wa-bi-hāmišihi Ḥāšiya li-Šayḫ al-islām ... Sayyidī Muḥammad al-Ḥifnī (Cairo: al-Maṭbaʻa al-ḫayriyya, 1307).
Morin, Didier 2015. Dictionnaire historique afar (1288-1982). Nouvelle édition augmentée (Paris: Karthala, 2015).
al-Šāṭibī, Ibrāhīm b. Mūsā s.a. al-Iʻtiṣām, ed. Muḥammad Rašīd Riḍā (Miṣr: al-Maktaba al-tiǧāriyya al-kubrā, s.a.).

al-Ušmūnī, ʻAlī b. Muḥammad, al-Rifāʻī, Aḥmad, and al-Ṣabbān, Abū al-ʻIrfān Muḥammad b. ʻAlī 1343. Ḥāšiyat al-Ṣabbān (2) ʻalā šarḥ al-Ušmūnī ʻalā al-Alfiyya ... wa-bi-hāmišihi šarḥ al-ʻallāma al-Ušmūnī maʻa baʻḍ taqrīrāt li-al-ʻālim al-ʻallāma al-Šayḫ Aḥmad al-Rifāʻī (Cairo: al-Maktaba al-azhariyya, 1343).
Ibn Qayyim al-Ǧawziyya 1367. al-Ǧawāb al-kāfi li-man sa’ala ʻan al-dawā’ al-šāfī, ed. Muḥammad Ḥāmid al-Fiqī (Miṣr: Maktabat wa-maṭbaʻat Muḥammad ʻAlī Ṣubayḥ wa-awlāduhu, 1367).

al-Šinšawrī, ʻAbd Allāh b. Muḥammad, [Sibṭ al-Māridīnī, Muḥammad b. Muḥammad], and Riḍā al-Dīn Abū Bakr b. Aḥmad b. ʻAbd al-Raḥmān al-Sabtī s.a. Fatḥ al-qarīb al-muǧīb bi-šarḥ kitāb al-tartīb ... wa-bi-hāmišihi kitāb Šarḥ al-raḥbiyya (al-Ṣafā, al-Makka al-Mukarrama: Maktabat al-Naḥḍa al-Waṭaniyya, s.a.).
Ibn Qayyim al-Ǧawziyya 1390. Zād al-maʻād (2) fī hady ḫayr al-ʻibād, ed. Ṭaha ʻAbd al-Ra’ūf Ṭaha (Miṣr: Šarikat Maktabat wa-Maṭbaʻat Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa-Awlāduhu, 1390).
al-Bayhaqī, Aḥmad b. al-Ḥusayn 1389. Dalā’il al-nubuwwa li-al-Bayhaqī, ed. ʻAbd al-Raḥmān Muḥammad ʻUṯmān (al-Madīna al-munawwara: al-Maktaba al-salafiyya, 1389).

al-Madanī, Muḥammad and al-Suyūṭī, Ǧalāl al-Dīn ʻAbd al-Raḥmān 1333. al-Itḥāfāt al-saniyya fī al-aḥādīṯ al-qudsiyya; Masālik al-ḥunafā’ fī wāliday al-Muṣṭafā; al-Maqāma al-sundusiyya fī al-nisba al-muṣtawfiyya; Inbā’ al-aḏkiyā’ fī ḥayāt al-anbiyā’ (Ḥaydarābād al-Dakkan: Dā’irat al-Maʻārif al-Niẓāmiyya, 1333).

Faḫr al-Dīn al-Rāzī and Abū al-Suʻūd, Muḥammad b. Muḥammad 1324. Mafātīḥ al-ġayb al-muštahir bi-al-tafsīr al-kabīr ... wa-bi-hāmišihi Tafsīr al-ʻallāma Abī al-Suʻūd (Miṣr: al-Maṭbaʻa al-ʻĀmira al-Šarafiyya, 1324).
Lirola Delgado, J. y Puerta Vílchez, J. M. 2004. Biblioteca de al-Andalus IV (Almería: Fundación Ibn Tufayl de Estudios Árabes, 2004).
Encyclopaedia of Islam III Online n.d.

al-ʻAṭṭār, Ḥasan, al-Subkī, Tāǧ al-Dīn, al-Širbīnī, ʻAbd al-Raḥmān, and Muḥammad ʻAlī b. Ḥusayn al-Mālikī s.a. Ḥāšiyat al-ʻAṭṭār ʻalā Ǧamʻ al-ǧawāmiʻ ... wa-bi-hāmišihi Taqrīr al-Širbīnī ʻalā Ǧamʻ al-ǧawāmiʻ ... wa-bi-asfal al-ṣulb wa-al-hāmiš Taqrīrāt al-šayḫ Muḥammad ʻAlī b. Ḥusayn al-Mālikī ... waḍaʻnā al-šarḥ al-maḏkūr bi-aʻlā al-ṣaḥīfa (Miṣr: al-Maktaba al-tiǧāriyya al-kubrā, s.a.).

Muḥammad b. Muḥammad al-Amīr, ʻAbd al-Salām al-Mālikī, and al-Laqānī 1368. Ḥāšīyat al-Šayḫ Muḥammad b. Muḥammad al-Amīr ʻAlā Šarḥ al-Šayḫ ʻAbd al-Salām b. Ibrāhīm al-Mālikī li-Ǧawharat al-Tawḥīd li’l-Imām al-Laqānī wa bi-Hāmišihā Itḥāf al-Murīd Šarḥ al-Šāyḫ ʻAbd al-Salām al-Mālikī ʻalā Ǧawharat al-Tawḥīd, eds Muḥammad Amīn ʻImrān and Rustom Muṣṭafā al-Ḥalabī (al-Qāhira: Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī, 1368).

al-Šaʻrānī, ʻAbd al-Wahhāb and Aḥmad b. ʻIṭā’ Allāh al-Iskandarī 1357. Laṭā’if al-minan wa-al-aḫlāq fī bayān wuǧūb al-taḥadduṯ bi-niʻmat Allāh ʻalā al-iṭlāq ... wuḍiʻa bi-hāmišihi kitābān (1) Laṭā’if al-minan fī manāqib Abī al-ʻAbbās al-Mursī wa-šayḫihi Abī al-Ḥasan; (2) Miftāḥ al-falāḥ wa-miṣbāḥ al-arwāḥ (Miṣr: ʻAbd al-Ḥamīd Aḥmad Ḥanafī, 1357).

Ḥāsiyat al-ʻAllāma al-Fāḍil wa-al-Qudwa (2) al-Kāmil al-Šayḫ Ibrāhīm al-Bāǧūrī ʻalā Šarḥ alʻAllāmā Ibn Qāsim al-Ġazzī ʻalā Matn al-Šāyḫ Abī Šuǧāʻ fī Maǧhab al-Imam al-Šāfiʻī n.d. (al-Qāhira: al-Maṭbaʻa al-Maymaniyya, ).

Ibn Ḥaǧar al-Haytamī 1308. al-Sawāʻiq al-Muḥriqa fī al-Radd ʻalā Ahl al-Bidaʻ wa al-Zandaqa wa bi-Hamišihi Kitāb Taṭhīr al-Ǧinān wa al-Lisān ʻan al-Ḫuṭūr wa al-Tafawwuh bi-Ṯalb Sayyidina Muʻāwiya b. Abī Sufiyān (al-Qāhira: Maṭbaʻa al-ʻĀmiriyya, 1308).

ʻAbd al-Raḥmān b. Muḥāmmad Bāʻlāwī and ʻAlī Bāṣīrī 1952. Kitāb Buġyat al-Mustaršidīn fī Talḫīṣ Fatāwā baʻḍ al-A’imma min al-ʻUlamā’ al-muta’aḫḫirīn maʻa ḍamm fawā’id ǧamma min kutub šattā wa bi-hāmišihi Ġāyat talḫīṣ almrād min Fatāwā Ibn Ziyād wa bi-hāmišihi ayḍan Kitāb Iṯmiḏ al-ʻaynayn fī baʻḍ iḫtilāf al-šāyḫayn Ibn Ḥaǧar al-Haytamī wa alŠams al-Ramlī ([al-Qāhira]: [Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī], 1952).
Muḥsin al-Amīn al-ʻĀmilī 1403. Aʻyān al-šīʻa, ed. Ḥasan al-Amīn (Bayrūt: Dār al-taʻāruf li-al-maṭbūʻāt, 1403).
Aġā Bozorg al-Ṭahrānī 1983. al-Ḏarīʻa ilā taṣānīf al-šīʻa (Dār al-Aḍwā’ li-al-Ṭibāʻa wa-al-Našr wa-al-Tawzīʻ, 1983).

Faraǧ ʻAbd al-Salām al-Sawqī, ʻAlī ʻAbd al-Munʻim ʻAbd al-Ḥamīd, ʻAbd al-Ḥalīm Muḥammad Sulaymān al-Dasūqī, Raǧab al-Hādī Ḍayāf, and Ibrāhīm Aḥmad al-Ḫalīǧī 1398. al-Tarbiya al-islāmiyya li-al-ṣaff al-awwal al-iʻdādī (s.l.: Amānat al-taʻlīm wa-al-tarbiya, al-Ǧamāhīriyya al-ʻArabiyya al-Lībiyya, 1398).
Lirola Delgado, J. y Puerta Vílchez, J. M. 2004. Biblioteca de al-Andalus II (Almería: Fundación Ibn Tufayl de Estudios Árabes, 2004).

Muḥammad b. Yaḥyā al-Tādifī al-Ḥanbalī 1317. Qalā’id al-Ǧawāhir fī manāqib al-šayḫ ʻAbd al-Qādir al-fard al-ǧāmiʻ al-rabbānī al-haykal al-lāmiʻ al-nūrānī sayydinā al-Šayḫ Muḥīy al-Dīn ʻAbd al-Qādir al-Ǧīlānī (al-Qāhira: Maṭbaʻa al-Maymaniyya / Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī, 1317).
Naǧm al-Dīn al-Ġazzī 1997. al-Kawākib al-Sā’ira bi-Aʻiyān al-Mi’ā al-ʻĀšira, ed. Ḫalīl Manṣūr (Bayrūt: Dār al-Kutub al-ʻIlmiyya, 1997).
al-Ḫazraǧī, Aḥmad b. ʻAbd Allāh 1322. Ḫulāṣat taḏhīb al-kamāl fī asmā’ al-riǧāl (Miṣr: al-Maṭbaʻa al-Ḫayriyya, 1322).
Sayyid b. Ḥusayn al-ʻAffānī 2006. Wā Muḥammadāh: Inna šāni’aka huwa al-abtar (Cairo: Dār al-ʻAffānī, 2006).
Aḥmad Šawqī 1939. al-Šawqiyyāt (Cairo: Maṭbaʻat Miṣr, 1939).
ʻAbd al-Malik b. Hišām 1404. al-Sīra al-nabawiyya li-Ibn Hišām, ed. Ṭaha ʻAbd al-Ra’ūf Saʻd (al-Qāhira: Maktabat al-Kulliyya al-Azhariyya, 1404).

Maǧmūʻat al-ṣarf taštamil ʻalā ǧumlat rasā’il fī ʻilm al-ṣarf: al-Šāfiya, al-Marāḥ, Kitāb ʻIzzī, al-Maqṣūd, Kitāb al-binā’, Kitāb amṯila muḫtalifa 1419. (Addis Ababa: Mu’assasa al-Naǧāšī li-al-Ṭabʻ wa-al-Našr, 1419).
Iḥsān Muḥammad Daḥlān 1426. Sirāǧ al-ṭālibīn: Šarḥ ʻalā minhāǧ al-ʻābidīn ilā ǧannat rabb al-ʻālamīn li-al-imām ḥuǧǧat al-islām Abī Ḥāmid Muḥammad b. Muḥammad al-Ġazzalī (Beyrut: Dār al-Fikr, 1426).
al-Ǧāmī, Muḥammad Amān b. ʻAlī 1399. Aḍwāʼ ʻalā ṭarīq al-daʻwa ilā al-Islām (Bayrūt - Dimašq: Al-maktab al-Islāmī, 1399).
Macdonald, D. B. n.d. Encyclopaedia of Islam, II Edition, Online, eds P. Bearman, Th. Bianquis, C. E. Bosworth, E. J. van Donzel, and W. P. Heinrichs (Leiden: Brill, ).
al-ʻImrāwī, ʻAbd al-Ḥayy and Murād, ʻAbd al-Karīm 1404. Al-taḥḏīr min al-iġtirār bi-mā ǧāʼ fī Kitāb al-ḥiwār (Rabat: Maṭbaʻa al-maʻarīf al-Ǧadīda, 1404).
Muḥammad al-Ḥasan ʻAlawī al-Mālikī 1387. al-Ǧazr wa-al-madd fī aḥkām al-ǧadd (Ḥaydarābād al-Dakkan: Maǧlis Dā’rat al-Maʻārif al-ʻUṯmāniyya, 1387).

Abū al-Faḍl ʻImād al-Dīn Ǧamīl Ḥalīm al-Ḥusaynī 1427. Asrār al-āṯār al-nabawiyya - adilla šarʻiyya wa-ḥālāt šifā’iyya wa-ṣuwar nādira li-al-āṯār al-muḥammadiyya ([Bayrūt]: Šarikat Dār al-Mašārīʻ, 1427).

Daḥlān, Aḥmad b. Zaynī and al-Samarqandī, Abū al-Qāsim b. Abī Bakr s.a. Maǧmūʻ ḫams rasā’il: (1) Risāla ka-al-ḥāšiya ʻalā matn al-Samarqandiyya wa-al-matn bi-al-hāmiš, (2) Risāla fī al-istiʻārāt, (3) Risāla mutaʻallaqa bi-ǧā’a Zayd, (4) Risāla fī al-naḥw mutaʻallaqa bi-al-mabniyyāt, (5) Risālat maqūlāt al-ʻilm (Miṣr: Dār Iḥyā’ al-Kutub al-ʻArabiyya, s.a.).
al-Šaʻrānī, ʻAbd al-Wahhāb and al-Ġazzālī, Muḥammad b. Muḥammad s.a. Tanbīh al-muġtarrīn ... wa-bi-hāmišihi kitāb al-Kašf wa-al-tabyīn fī ġurūr al-ḫalq aǧmaʻīn (Miṣr: Maṭbaʻat al-Maymaniyya, s.a.).

al-Qārī al-Harawī, ʻAlī b. Sulṭān Muḥammad and Zakariyyā’ al-Anṣārī, Abū Yaḥyā 1367. al-Minaḥ al-fikriyya šarḥ al-Muqaddima al-ǧazariyya ... wa-bi-hāmišihā šarḥ Abī Yaḥyā Zakariyyā’ al-Anṣārī ʻalā al-Muqaddima al-ǧazariyya (Miṣr: Šarikat Maktabat wa-Maṭbaʻat Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa-Awlāduhu, 1367).
Ibn al-Ǧazarī, Muḥammad b. Muḥammad 1349. al-Ḥiṣn al-ḥaṣīn min kalām Sayyid al-Mursalīn (Miṣr: Maṭbaʻat Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa-Awlāduhu, 1349).
ʻAbd al-Ḥamīd Quds 1330. Laṭā’if al-išārāt ilā šarḥ Tashīl al-ṭuruqāt (Cairo: 1330).
Aḥmad al-Ṣāwī n.d. Ḥāšiyat al-Ṣāwī ʻalā Tafsīr al-Ǧalālayn ([al-Qāhira?]: ʻAbd al-Ḥamīd Aḥmad Ḥanafī, n.d.).
ʻAbd al-Ǧalīl b. Muḥammad Ibn ʻAẓẓūm 1930. Tanbīh al-anām fī bayān ʻulūw maqām nabiyyinā Muḥammad ʻalayhi al-ṣalāt wa-al-salām (al-Qāhira: al-Maktaba al-Tiǧāriyya al-Kubrā, 1930).

al-Ġamrāwī, Muḥammad Zuhrī and Ibn al-Naqīb, Aḥmad b. Lu’lu’ 1348. Anwār al-masālik šarḥ ʻUmdat al-sālik wa-ʻuddat al-nāsik ... [maʻa matn] ʻUmdat al-sālik (Miṣr: Matbaʻat Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī, 1348).
Aḥmad b. Muḥammad al-Maqqarī 1968. Nafḥ al-ṭīb min ġuṣn al-Andalus al-raṭīb, ed. Iḥsān ʻAbbās (Bayrūt: Dār Ṣādir, 1968).

al-Sayyid ʻAbd al-ʻAzīz b. al-Sayyid Hāšim al-Idrīsī, ed., n.d. al-Munāẓara al-kubrā bayna ʻayn aʻyān li-ummat al-hādiyyīn [...] al-Sayyid Aḥmad b. Idrīs wa-fuqahā’ al-wahhābiyya, al-Maktaba al-taḫaṣṣuṣiyya li-al-radd ʻalā al-wahhābiyya ([Makka]: Maktabat Umm al-Qurā, ).
Maǧallat Nūr al-islām n.d.
Maǧallat al-rābiṭa al-islāmiyya n.d.
al-Malibārī, Zayn al-Dīn b. ʿAlī 1991. Sirāǧ al-qulūb wa-ʻilāǧ al-ḏunūb, eds Muʿawwad, ʿAlī Muḥammad and ʿAbd al-Mawǧūd, ʿAdil Aḥmad (al-Qāhira: Maktabat al-Zahrā’, 1991).

Muḥammad ʻIlīš 1306. Hidāyat al-murīd li-ʻaqīdat ahl al-tawḥīd […] wa bi-hāmišihi Šarḥ al-Ustāḏ al-maḏkūr al-musammā bi-al-Futūḥāt al-ilāhiyya al-wahbiyya ‘alā al-manẓūma al-Maqariyya al-musammāt Iḍāʻat al-duǧunna fī i‘tiqād ahl al-sunna […]. (al-Qāhira: Maṭbaʻat Afandī Muṣṭāfā, 1306).

al-Fīrūzābādī, Muḥammad b. Yaʻqūb 1330. al-Qāmūs al-muḥīṭ (Cairo: al-Maṭbaʻa al-Ḥusayniyya al-Miṣriyya, 1330).
Ibn Hišām, ʻAbd Allāh b. Yūsuf 1937. Muġnī al-labīb - Ḥāšiyat ḫātimat al-muḥaqqiqīn wa-ʻumdat al-a’imma al-mudaqqiqīn (Cairo: al-Maktaba al-tiǧāriyya al-kubrā, 1937).
Al-Šarqāwī and al-Hudhudī 189 AD. Al-Šarqāwī ʻalā al-Hudhudī (Cairo: Dār al-Iḥyā’ al-kutub al-ʻarabiyya, 189 AD).
ʻAbd al-Qādir al-Ǧīlānī 2000. Al-fuyūḍāt al-rabbāniyya fī al-maʼāṯir wa-l-awrād al-Qādiriyya (al-Qāhira: al-Maktaba al-Azhariyya li-l-turāṯ, 2000).
ʻUmar Riḍā Kaḥḥāla 1414. Muʻǧam al-mu’allifīn. Tarāǧim muṣannifī al-kutub al-ʻarabiyya (Bayrūt: Mu’assasa al-risāla, 1414).

Šarḥ Kāšifat al-siǧā ʻalā Safīnat al-naǧā fī uṣūl al-dīn wa al-fiqh; wa-qad ṭurriza hāmiš hāḏā al-kitāb bi-kitābayn (1) matn hāḏā al-šarḥ; (2) kitāb al-Riyāḍ al-badī‘a fī uṣūl al-Dīn wa-ba‘ḍ furū‘ al-šarī‘a ʻalā maḏhab al-Imām al-Šāfiʻī, ed. Ibrāhīm b. Ḥasan al-Inbābī (al-Qāhira: Muṣṭafā al-Babī al-Ḥalabī wa Awlādihi, 1343).

Muḥammad b. Qāsim al-Ġazzī al-Šāfiʻī and Abū Šūǧāʻ, Aḥmad b. al-Ḥusayn al-Iṣfahānī 1952. Fatḥ al-qarīb al-muǧīb šarḥ Muḥammad b. Qāsim al-Ġazzī al-Šāfiʻī ʻalā al-kitāb al-musamma bi’l-Taqrīb, ed. Aḥmad Saʻd ʻAlī (al-Qāhira: Muṣṭafā al-Babī al-Ḥalabī wa Awlādihi, 1952).
al-Murtaḍā al-Zabīdī, Muḥammad b. Muḥammad 1994. Tāǧ al-ʻarūs min ǧawāhir al-qāmūs, vol. 1-20, ed. ʻAlī Šayrī (Bayrūt: Dār al-Fikr, 1994).
Ibn Kaṯīr, Abū al-Fidā’ Ismāʻīl n.d. Šamā’il al-Rasūl wa dalā’il nubuwwatihi wa faḍāiluhu wa ḫaṣā’iṣuhu, ed. Muṣṭafā ʻAbd al-Wāḥid (Bayrūt: Dār al-Maʻrifa, ).
Ibn Mālik, Muḥammad b. ʻAbd Allāh s.a. Alfiyyat Ibn Mālik fī al-naḥw wa-al-ṣarf, eds ʻAbd al-Fattāḥ al-Ṣaʻīdī and Ḥusayn Yūsuf Mūsā (Singapore, Penang: Sulaymān Farʻī, s.a.).
al-Rāzī, Muḥammad b. Abī Bakr 1417. Tuḥfat al-mulūk fī fiqh maḏhab al-Imām Abī Ḥanīfa al-Nuʻmān, ed. ʻAbd Allāh Nadīr Aḥmad (Bayrūt: Dār al-Bašā’ir al-Islāmiyya, 1417).

al-Damīrī, Muḥammad b. Mūsā b. ʻῙsā Kamāl al-Dīn and al-Qazwīnī, Zakariyyā’ b. Muḥammad ibn Maḥmūd 1376. Ḥayāt al-ḥayawān al-kubrā ... wa-yalīhi ʻAǧā’ib al-maḫlūqāt wa-ġarā’ib al-mawǧūdāt (Cairo: Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa-Awlāduhu, 1376).

al-Qarāfī, Šihāb al-Dīn Abū al-ʻAbbās al-Ṣinhāǧī and Ibn Šāṭṭ, Qāsim b. ʻAbd Allāh al-Anṣārī n. d. al-Furūq li-al-Imām Šihāb al-Dīn Abī al-ʻAbbās al-Ṣinhāǧī al-mašhūr bi-al-Qarāfī ... wa-bi-asfalihā ḥāšiyat ... Ibn al-Šāṭṭ al-musammā Idrār al-šurūq ʻalā anwār al-furūq ... wa-bi-hāmiš al-kitābayn Tahḏīb al-furūq wa-al-qawāʻid al-saniyya fī al-asrār al-fiqhiyya li-mu’allifihi Muḥammad ʻAlī b. Ḥusayn (Beirut: Dār al-maʻrifa, n. d.).

Aḥmad al-Tīǧānī, Abū al-ʻAbbās b. Maḥammad b. al-Muḫtār, ʻAlī Ḥarāzim b. al-ʻArabī Barāda, and ʻUmar al-Fūtī al-Ṭūdī al-Kadwī 1937. Ǧawāhir al-maʻānī wa bulūġ al-amānī fī fayḍ Abī ʻAbbās al-Tiǧānī - Kitāb Rimāḥ ḥizb al-Raḥīm ʻalā nuḥūr ḥizb al-Raǧīm (al-Qāhira: ʻAbbās b. ʻAbd al-Salām b. Šaqrūn, 1937).

al-Nawawī, Muḥammad b. ʻUmar b. ʻArabī al-Ǧāwī 1936. Nūr al-ẓulām šarḥ Manẓumat ʻAqīdat al-ʻawāmm, eds Aḥmad Saʻd ʻAlī, Muḥammad Amīn ʻImrān, and Rustom Muṣṭafā al-Ḥalabī (al-Qāhira: [Muṣtafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī], 1936).
ʻAbd al-Qādir al-Ǧīlānī n. d. Al-fuyūḍāt al-rabbāniyya (Cairo: Maṭbaʻat al-umma Bahǧat al-darb al-aḥmar, n. d.).
Robinson, David 1985. The Holy War of Umar Tal (Oxford: Oxford University Press, 1985).

al-Nawawī, Muḥammad b. ʻUmar b. ʻArabī al-Ǧāwī and Aḥmad b. Zayn al-Ḥabašī n.d. Bahǧat al-wasā’il bi-šarḥ al-masā’il ʻalā al-Rišālā al-ǧāmiʻa bayna uṣūl al-dīn wa al-fish wa al-taṣawwuf (al-Qāhira: ).
Kitāb Iḥiyā’ ʻulūm al-dīn 1321. ([al-Qāhira]: al-Maṭbaʻa al-ʻĀmira al-Šarqiyya, 1321).

al-Nawawī, Muḥammad b. ʻUmar and al-Barzanǧī, Ǧaʻfar b. Ḥasan 1340. Madāriǧ al-ṣuʻūd (2) ilā iktisā’ al-burūd ... šarḥ ʻalā al-Mawlid al-nabawī ... wa-bi-hāmišihi al-Mawlid al-maḏkūr (Miṣr: Maṭbaʻat Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa-Awlāduhu, 1340).

Muḥammad Ḥaqqī al-Nāzilī and Ibn al-Ǧazarī, Muḥammad b. Muḥammad 1349. Ḫazīnat al-asrār al-kubrā ǧalīlat al-aḏkār ... wa-yalīhi al-Ḥiṣn al-ḥaṣīn min kalām sayyid al-mursalīn (Miṣr: Šarikat Maktabat wa-Maṭbaʻat Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa-Awlādihi, 1349).
Padwick, Constance E. 1961. Muslim Devotions: A Study of Prayer-Manuals in Common Use (London: SPCK, 1961).
Aḥzāb wa-awrād Aḥmad al-Tiǧānī n.d. (Cairo: ).
Ibn al-Wardī 1939. Ḫarīdat al-ʻaǧā’ib wa-farīdat al-ġarā’ib (Cairo: Muṣtafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī, 1939).
ʻAbd al-ʻAzīz Sayyid al-Ahl 1353. al-Ḫalīfa al-zāhid ʻUmar b. ʻAbd al-ʻAzīz (Bayrūt: Dār al-ʻIlm al-Malāyīn, 1353).
Ǧaʻfar b. Ḥasan b. ʻAbd al-Karīm al-Barzanǧī n.d. Manẓūmat Ahl Badr al-musammāt bi-Ǧāliyyat al-Kadar (Singapore: Maṭbaʻat Sulaymān Marʻī, ).
Khaled el-Rouayheb 2015. Islamic Intellectual History in the Seventeenth Century. Scholarly Currents in the Ottoman Empire and the Maghreb (Cambridge: Cambridge University Press, 2015).
Dalīl al-ḥāǧǧ wa-al-muʻtamar n.d. (Jeddah: Markaz al-Daʻwa wa-al-iršād bi-Ǧidda, ).
Maḥmūd b. Sulaymān al-Tiǧānī 1959. al-Manhal al-aṣfā fī ziyārat al-Nabī al-Muṣtafā (al-Qāhira: Muṣtafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī, 1959).

Baḫraq al-Yamanī al-Ḥaḍramī, Muḥammad b. ʻUmar s.a. Tuḥfat al-aḥbāb wa-ṭurfat al-aṣḥāb ... wa-wuḍiʻa bi-hāmišihi baʻḍ taqyīdāt wa-fawā’id ǧalīla min šarḥ al-mu’allif wa-al-Fākihī wa-al-Yamanī wa-ġayruhā li-al-fā’ida wa-ziyāda fī nafʻ al-ṭullāb (Miṣr: Maṭbaʻat Dār Iḥyā’ al-Kutub al-ʻArabiyya, s.a.).
Ǧamāl al-Dīn al-Annī 1337. Kifāyat al-ṭālibīn (al-Qāhira: Maṭbaʻat Maṭar, 1337).
Ḫālid Muḥammad Ḫālid 1999. Riǧāl ḥawla al-Rasūl (Bayrūt: Dār al-Kutub al-ʻIlmiyya, 1999).

ʻAbd al-Raḥmān al-Ṣafūrī al-Šāfiʻī and ʻAbd al-ʻAzīz al-Dīrīnī n.d. Nuzhat al-maǧālis wa muntaḫab al-nafā’is wa bi-hāmišihā kitāb Ṭahārat al-qulūb wal-ḫuḍūʻ li-ʻallām al-ġuyūb (al-Qāhira: ʻĪsā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa Šurakā’hu, ).

Ǧamāl al-Dīn al-Annī 1433. al-Naǧm al-munīr, fī iršād man yurīd al-safar ilā al-āḫira wa-yasīr, ed. Muḥammad b. Ḥāmī al-Dīn b. ʻAbd al-Ṣamad al-Wollowī al-Būranī, Silsilat mu’allifāt al-Šayḫ ... Ǧamāl al-Dīn Muḥammad al-Annī (Addīs Abābā: Maktabat al-Sunna, 1433).

Abū al-Suʻūd Muḥammad b. Muḥammad al-ʻImādī 1928. Tafsīr Abī al-Suʻūd al-musammā Iršād al-ʻaql al-salīm ilā mazāyā al-Qur’ān al-karīm, eds al-Šāyḫ Ḥasan Muḥammad al-Masʻūdī and Muḥammad Muḥammad ʻAbd al-Laṭīf (al-Qāhira: al-Maṭbaʻa al-Miṣriyya, 1928).
al-Sayyid Muḥammad b. ʻAlawī al-Mālikī al-Ḥasanī n.d. al-Madḥ al-nabawī bayn al-ġuluww wa al-inṣāf, Silsila Īḍāḥ mafāhīm al-sunna al-nabawiyya, 1 (al-Qāhira: Dār Wahdān liìl-Ṭibāʻa wa al-Našr, ).

al-Qārī al-Harawī, ʻAlī b. Sulṭān Muḥammad and Zakariyyā’ al-Anṣārī, Abū Yaḥyā 1347. al-Minaḥ al-fikriyya šarḥ matn al-Ǧazariyya ... wa-bi-hāmišihi šarḥ al-ʻallāma Šayḫ al-islām Zakarīyā’ al-Anṣārī ʻalā al-Muqaddima al-ǧazariyya ayḍan (Miṣr: Maṭbaʻat Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa-Awlāduhu, 1347).

Ibn Mālik, Abū ʻAbd Allāh Ǧamāl al-Dīn Muḥammad b. ʻAbd Allāh 1888. Manuel pour l’étude des grammairiens arabes: la ’Alfiyyah d’Ibn Mālik, suivi du Lāmiyyah du meme auteur, ed. Goguyer, Antoine (Bayrūt: Imprimerie des Belles-lettres, 1888).
Ismāʻīl Ḥaqqī al-Burūswī 1927. Tafsīr rūḥ al-bayān (Istanbul: ʻUṯmān Bey Maṭbaʻası, 1927).

ʻAbd al-Raḥmān b. Muḥāmmad Bāʻlāwī and ʻAlī Bāṣīrī 1325. Kitāb Buġyat al-mustaršidīn (2) fī talḫīṣ fatāwā ba‘ḍ al-a’imma min al-‘ulamā’ al-muta’aḫḫirīn [...] wa-bi-hāmišihi Kitāb Iṯmiḏ al-ʻaynayn fī baʻḍ iḫtilāf al-šayḫayn Ibn Ḥaǧar al-Haytamī wa-al-Šams al-Ramlī [...] ṯumma yalīhi bi-al-hāmiš ayḍan Kitāb Ġāyat Talḫīṣ al-Murād min Fatāwā Ibn Ziyād (Cairo: Muṣtafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī, 1325).

al-Bannānī, Ǧalāl al-Dīn al-Maḥallī, and al-Širbīnī, ʻAbd al-Raḥmān n.d. Ḥāšiyat al-ʻallāma al-Bannānī ʻalā šarḥ al-Ǧalāl al-Maḥallī ʻalā Ǧamʻ al-Ǧawāmiʻ li-al-imām Ibn al-Subkī - wa-ʻalā hāmišīhi al-šarḥ al-maḏkūr wa-baʻḍ taqrīrāt li-al-ʻālim al-ʻallāma al-šayḫ ʻAbd al-Raḥmān al-Širbīnī, ed. Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥālabī wa aḫawayihi Bakrī wa ʻĪsā (al-Qāhira: Dār al-Kutub al-ʻArabiyya al-Kubrā, ).
Maǧmūʻ al-mutūn al-kabīr: muštamil ʻalā 63 matnan min muhimmāt al-mutūn fī muḫtalif al-ʻulūm wa-al-funūn 1378. (al-Qāhira: al-Maktaba al-Tiǧāriyya al-Kubrā, 1378).

al-ʻAṭṭār, Ḥasan b. Muḥammad and al-Širbīnī, ʻAbd al-Raḥmān 1898. Ḥāšiyat al-ʻAṭṭār ʻalā šarḥ al-Ǧalāl al-Maḥallī ʻalā Ǧamʻ al-Ǧawāmiʻ li’l-Subkī - wa bi-hāmišihi Taqrīr li-ʻAbd al-Raḥmān al-Širbīnī ʻalā Ǧamʻ al-ǧāwāmiʻ (al-Qāhira: al-Maṭbaʻa al-ʻIlmiyya, 1898).
ʻAbd al-Qādir b. Aḥmad al-Ḫaṭīb al-Ṭarābulusī 1312. Risāla fī taḥrīr al-maqādīr al-šarʻiyya ʻalā maḏhab al-a’imma al-arbaʻa al-muǧtahidīn (Būlāq: al-Maṭbaʻa al-Amīriyya, 1312).
al-Fayyūmī, Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. ʻAlī al-Maqqarī 1980. al-Miṣbaḥ al-Munīr fī ġarīb al-Šarḥ al-Kabīr li’l-Rifāʻī, ed. Muṣṭafā al-Šaqā (al-Qāhira: Muṣtafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa Awlādihi bi-Miṣr, 1980).

al-Qayrawānī, Ibn Abī Zayd and Ṣāliḥ ʻAbd al-Samīʻ al-Ābī al-Azharī n.d. Risālat al-Imām Ibn Abī Zayd al-Qayrawānī wa bi-hamišihā al-šarḥ al-musammā al-Ṯamar al-dānī fī taqrīb al-maʻānī (al-Qāhira: Maktabat al-Qāhira, ).

Ibrāhīm b. Muḥammad al-Bāǧūrī and Ḫālid al-Azharī 1344. Ḥāšiyat ... Ibrāhīm al-Bāǧūrī ʻalā matn al-Burda (2) ... wa-bi-hāmišihā Šarḥ al-Šayḫ Ḫālid al-Azharī ʻalā al-Burda ayḍan (Cairo: al-Maṭbaʻa al-Maḥmūdiyya al-tiǧāriyya, 1344).

al-Nawāwī, Muḥammad b. ʻUmar b. ʻArabī al-Ǧāwī and al-Ġazzālī, Abū Ḥāmid Muḥammad b. Muḥammad al-Ṭūsī 1343. Šarḥ Marāqī al-ʻubūdiyya [...] ʻalā matn Bidāyat al-hidāya ... wa-bi-hāmišihi Bidāya al-hidāya al-maḏkūra (Cairo: Muṣtafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī, 1343).
Abū Rīma, Muḥammad al-Maḥmūd al-Naǧǧār 1922. Hidāyat al-mustafīd fī aḥkām al-taǧwīd (Miṣr: Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī, 1922).
‘Alī b. Aḥmad al-‘Azīzī al-Būlāqī al-Šāfi‘ī 1357. al-Sirāǧ al-munīr šarḥ al-Ǧāmi‘ al-ṣaġīr fī ḥadīṯ al-bašīr al-naḏīr (Cairo: ʻĪsā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī, 1357).
al-Qināwī, Masʻūd b. Ḥasan b. Abī Bakr 1346. Fatḥ al-raḥīm al-raḥmān (al-Qāhira: Muḥammad ʻAlī Ṣubayḥ wa-Awlāduhu, 1346).

ʻAbd al-Raḥmān b. Muḥammad b. Yaḫlaftan b. Aḥmad b. Taflīt al-Fāzāzī al-Yaǧfašī Abū Zayd, Abū Bakr Muḥammad al-Mahīb, Yūsuf al-Nabahānī, and Ibn Ǧābir al-Andalusī s.a. al-Wasā’il al-mutaqabbila fī madḥ al-Nabī ... wa-taḫmīsuhu li-al-Šayḫ al-imām Abī Bakr Muḥammad al-Mahīb...wa-yalīhi qaṣīdatayn (1) al-Sābiqāt al-ǧiyād (2) Qasīdat madḥ al-nabī fī al-tawriya bi-suwar al-Qur’ān (Cairo: Maktabat wa-maṭbaʻat al-Mašhad al-Ḥusaynī, s.a.).

al-Ḫuḍarī, Muḥammad, Ibn ʻAqīl, and Ibn Mālik 1319. Ḥāšiyat al-ʻālim al-ʻallāma [...] al-šāyḫ Muḥammd al-Ḫuḍarī [...] ʻalā Šarḥ al-muḥaqqiq al-ǧalīl al-ʻallāma al-himām Ibn ʻAqīl ʻala Alfiyyat al-imām Ibn Mālik - wa bi’l-hāmiš šarḥ Ibn ʻAqīl al-maḏkūr, ed. Muḥammad Ramaḍān (al-Qāhira: al-Maṭbaʻa al-Azhariyya al-Miṣriyya, 1319).

al-Fākihī, ʻAbd Allāh b. Aḥmad and al-Ḥaṭṭāb, Muḥammad b. Muḥammad 1322. Šarḥ al-Fawākih al-ǧaniyya ʻalā Mutammimat al-Āǧurrūmiyya ... wa-bi-hāmišihi matn ḏālika al-šarḥ wa-huwa Mutammimat al-Aǧurrūmiyya fī ʻilm al-ʻarabiyya (Miṣr: Matbaʻat al-Taqaddum al-ʻIlmiyya, 1322).
Abū Rīma, Muḥamamd al-Maḥmūd n.d. Hidāyat al-mustafīd fī aḥkām al-taǧwīd (Ḥalab: al-Maktaba al-Adabiyya - ʻUmar Muḥammad Rayḥāwī, ).
al-Anṣārī, Aḥmad b. ʻĪsā 1341. Kitāb šarḥ al-muqaddima al-ʻašmāwiyya - wa bi’l-hāmiš taʻalliqāt mufīda li’l-mu’allif (al-Qāhira: Muṣtafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa Awlādihi bi-Miṣr, 1341).

al-Baqarī, Muḥammad b. ʻUmar and al-Sibṭ al-Māridīnī n.d. Ḥāšiyat al-ʻālim al-ʻallāma [...] Muḥammad b. ʻUmar al-Baqarī ʻalā Šarḥ al-raḥbiyya li’l-imām Sibṭ al-Māridīnī - wa bi-hāmišihā al-Šarḥ al-maḏkūr li’l-imām al-Sibṭ al-Māridīnī ([al-Qāhira]: Maḥmūd Tawfīq al-Kutubī, ).
Mudarris Sālim ʻAlī and al-Maraġī, Aḥmad Muṣṭafā 1921. Tahḏīb al-tawḍīḥ (Egypt: Maṭbaʻat al-Saʻāda, 1921).
ʻUbayda b. Muḥammad al-Ṣaġīr al-Šinqīṭī 1348. Mīzāb al-raḥma al-rabbāniyya fī al-tarbiyya bi’l-ṭarīqa al-Tiǧāniyya, ed. Ibrāhīm Ḥasan al-Inbābī (al-Qāhira: Muṣtafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī, 1348).
Minhāǧ al-ʻābidīnli’l-šāyḫ ... Abī Ḥāmid al-Ġazālī - wa-bi-hāmišihi al-kitāb al-musammā Bidāyat al-hidāya n.d. (al-Qāhira: al-Maṭbaʻa al-Maymaniyya - Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī, ).

al-Nabahānī, Yūsuf b. Ismāʻīl n.d. Maǧmūʻ yaštamil ʻalā ṯalāṯa kutub: (1) al-Qaṣīda al-rā’iyya al-kubrā fī al-kamālāt al-ilāhiyya wa-al-sīra al-nabawiyya wa-waḍʻ al-milla al-islāmiyya wa-al-milal al-uḫrā, (2) Saʻādat al-anām fī atbāʻ dīn al-islām, (3) Muḫtaṣar Iršād al-ḥayārā fī taḥḏīr al-muslimīn min madāris al-naṣārā.

al-Nawāwī, Muḥammad b. ʻUmar b. ʻArabī al-Ǧāwī, Muḥammad Ḥasab Allāh al-Makkī, and Sālim b. ʻAbd Allāh b. Saʻd b. Samīr al-Ḥaḍramī 1332. Kāšifat al-siǧā - bi-hāmišihi (1) Matn Safīnat al-naǧā; (2) al-Riyāḍ al-badī‘a fī uṣūl al-dīn wa-ba‘ḍ furū‘ al-šarī‘a ʻalā maḏhab al-imam al-Šāfiʻī (al-Qāhira: Maṭbaʻa al-Ḫayriyya - al-Sayyid ʻUmar Ḥusayn al-Ḫaššāb, 1332).

‘Alawī b. Aḥmad al-Saqqāf and al-Malībārī, Zayn al-Dīn b. ʻAbd al-ʻAzīz 1311. Ḥāšiyat Fatḥ al-muʻīn al-musammā Taršīḥ al-mustafidīn bi-tawšīḥ Fatḥ al-muʻīn li-al-ʻallāma [...] al-Sayyd ʻAlawī b. al-Sayyid Aḥmad al-Saqqāf - wa bi-al-hāmiš Fatḥ al-muʻīn bi-šarḥ Qurrat al-ʻayn li-al-ʻallāma [...] al-šayḫ Zayn al-Dīn b. ʻAbd al-ʻAzīz al-Malībārī (Miṣr: al-Maṭbaʻa al-Maymaniyya, 1311).

al-Bāǧūrī, Ibrāhīm and Ibn Qāsim al-Ġazzī 1354. Ḥāšiyat al-Bāǧūrī ʻalā Ibn Qāsim - Šarḥ ... ʻalā matn al-Šayḫ Abī al-Šuǧāʻ fī maḏhab al-iimām al-Šāfiʻī - wa bi’l-hāmiš al-šarḥ al-maḏkūr (al-Qāhira: al-Maktaba al-Tiǧāriyya al-Kubrā - Muṣṭafā Muḥammad, 1354).
Tafsīr al-ʻušr al-aḫīr min al-Qur’ān al-karīm min kitāb Zubdat al-tafsīr wa-yalīhi aḥkām tahummu al-muslim n.d.

al-Ibšīhī, Šihāb al-Dīn Muḥammad b. Aḥmad Abī al-Fatḥ, Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm al-Aḥdab, and Ibn Ḥiǧǧa al-Ḥamawī, Taqī al-Dīn Abū Bakr b. ʻAlī b. Muḥammad al-Qādirī al-Ḥanafī 1368. al-Mustaṭraf fī kull fann al-mustaẓraf - wa bi’l-hāmiš Tamarāt al-awrāq fī al-muḥāḍarāt - wa yalīhī ḏaylān 1) li-Ibn Ḥiǧǧa al-Ḥamawī 2) li-Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm al-Aḥdab (al-Qāhira: ʻAbd al-Ḥamīd Aḥmad Ḥanafī, 1368).

al-Naẓīfī, Abū ʻAbd Allāh Muḥammad Fatḥā b. ʻAbd al-Wāḥid al-Sūsī s.a. Kitāb al-Durra al-ḫarīda šarḥ al-Yaqūta al-farīda - bi-ḏayl ṣaḥā’’ifihi kitāb al-Nafḥa al-rabbāniyya fī al-ṭarīqa al-Tiǧāniyya (Bayrūt - Wād Madanī (Sūdān): al-Maktaba al-Sanʻabaniyya? - Maktaba Maḍawī, s.a.).
Luwīs Maʻlūf al-Yasūʻī 1937. al-Munǧid muʻǧam madrasī li-al-luġa al-ʻarabiyya (Bayrūt: al-Maṭbaʻa al-Kātūlīkiyya li-al-Ābā’ al-Yasūʻiyyīn, 1937).
Theodor Nöldeke, Gotthelf Bergsträsser, Friedrich Schwally, and Otto Pretzl 2013. The History of the Qur’an, ed. Wolfgang Behn (Leiden: Brill, 2013).

al-Rāzī, Muḥammad b. Abī Bakr Zayn al-Dīn and al-ʻUkbarī, Muḥibb al-Dīn Abū al-Baqā’ ʻAbd Allāh b. al-Ḥusayn b. ʻAbd Allāh n.d. Imlā’ mā manna bihi al-raḥmān min wuǧūh al-iʻrāb wa-al-qirā’āt fī ǧamīʻ al-Qur’ān - wa buhāmišihi Umnūḏaǧ ǧalīl fī bayān as’ila wa aǧwiba min ġarā’ib Āy al-tanzīl (al-Qāhira: al-Maṭbaʻa al-Maymaniyya - Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī, ).

al-Bayḍāwī, Nāṣir al-Dīn Abū Saʻīd ʻAbd Allāh b. ʻumar b. Muḥammad al-Šīrāzī and al-Kāzarūnī, Abū al-Faḍl al-Qurašī al-Ṣiddīqī al-Ḫaṭīb 1330. Anwār al-tanzīl wa-asrār al-ta’wīl - wa bi-hāmišihi Ḥašīyat [...] Abī al-Faḍl al-Qurašī al-Ṣiddīqī al-Ḫaṭīb al-mašhūr bi-’l-Kāzarūnī (al-Qāhira: Dār al-Kutub al-ʻArabiyya al-Kubrā - Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa Aḫawayh Bakrī wa ʻĪsā, 1330).

ʻAbd al-Ḥaqq sibṭ al-ʻAllāma al-Nawawī al-ṯānī and al-Taftāzānī, Saʻd al-Dīn Masʻūd b. ʻUmar b. ʻAbd Allāh 1348. Tadrīǧ al-adānī ilā qirā’at šarḥ al-Saʻd ʻalā Taṣrīf al-Zanǧānī ... wa-bi-al-hāmiš al-šarḥ al-maḏkūr li-al-ḥibr al-Taftāzānī ʻalā matn al-Zanǧānī (Miṣr: Dār Iḥyā’ al-Kutub al-ʻArabiyya, 1348).
Yūsuf al-Nabahānī 1312. al-Naẓm al-badīʻ fī mawlid al-shafīʻ (Bayrūt: al-Maṭbaʻa al-adabiyya, 1312).

al-Šaʻrānī, ʻAbd al-Wahhāb and al-Ġazālī, Muḥammad b. Muḥammad n.d. Tanbīh al-muġtarrīn li’l-quṭb al-rabbānī [...] ʻAbd al-Wahhāb al-Šaʻrānī - wa bi-hāmišihi kitāb al-Kašf wa al-tabiyyn fī ġurūr al-ḫalq aǧmaʻīn (al-Qāhira: al-Maktaba al-Tiǧāriyya al-Kubrā - Muṣṭafā Muḥammad, ).
Muḥammad Yūsuf al-Kāndihlawī 2003. al-Aḥādīṯ al-muntaḫaba fī al-ṣifāt al-sitt li-al-daʻwa ilā Allāh taʻālā, ed. Muḥammad Saʻd al-Kāndihlawī (New Delhi: Idāra Išāʻāt Dīniyyāt, 2003).
Muhammed Rashaad Kabiir Abdullee Kabiir Muummayyaa Carcar Harar 1991. Fat-hgurraghmaan kan hiikkaa qur’aanaa kan afaan oromo’oo (Addīs Abābā: Maktabat Muṣʻab b. ʻAmīr al-Islāmiyya, 1991).
al-Qāšānī, ʻAbd al-Razzāq n.d. Tafsīr al-šayḫ al-akbar (al-Qāhira: Maṭbaʻa al-Maymaniyya - Muṣṭafā al_Bābī al-Ḥalabī, ).
Muḥammad al-Amīn al-Urumī al-Hararī al-Buwayṭī 1429. Manāhil al-riǧāl wa-marāḍiʻ al-aṭfāl bi-libān maʻānī Lāmiyyat al-afʻāl (Bayrūt: Dār Ṭawq al-Naǧā, 1429).
al-Amīr, Muḥammad b. Ismāʻīl al-Ṣanʻānī s.a. Subul al-salām šarḥ Bulūġ al-marām min ǧamʻ adillat al-aḥkām (al-Qāhira: Šarikat al-Quds li-al-Taṣdīr, s.a.).

Qara Bulūṭ, ʻAlī al-Riḍā and Qara Bulūṭ, Aḥmad Ṭūrān 2006. Muʻǧam al-ta’rīḫ al-turāṯ al-islāmiyya fī maktabāt al-ʻālam = Dünya kütüphanelerinde mevcut İslâm kültür tarihi ile ilgili eserler ansiklopedisi, İlmı̂ eserler serizi, 3 (Qayṣarī, Turkiyā: Dār al-ʻAqaba, 2006).
Aḥmad al-Tiǧānī 2012. Aḥzāb wa-awrād quṭb al-rabbānī wa-l-ʻārif al-ṣamdānī, ed. Muḥammad al-Ḥāfiẓ al-Tiǧānī (Fās [?]: Maṭbaʻat al-zāwiya al-Tiǧāniyya, 2012).
Muḥamamd b. ʻAbd al-Laṭīf n.d. Ḥaqīqa daʻwa al-šayḫ al-imām al-muǧaddid Muḥammad b. ʻAbd al-Wahhāb (al-Riyāḍ: Mu’assasa al-Nūr li’l-Ṭibāʻa wa al-Taǧlīd, ).
Muḥarram Efendī and al-Ǧāmī 1320. Ḥāšiyat Muḥarram (Istanbul: Ḫūršīd Maṭbaʻasi, 1320).
al-Dayrabī, Aḥmad b. ʻUmar 1956. Ġāyat al-maqṣūd li-man yataʻāṭā al-ʻuqūd (al-Qāhira: Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī, 1956).

Aḥmad b. Zaynī Daḥlān 1347. al-Durar al-saniyya fī al-radd ʻalā al-wahhābiyya - wa yalīhi Risālat al-naṣr fī ḏikr waqt al-ʻaṣr (al-Qāhira: Dār Iḥiyā’ al-Kutub al-ʻArabiyya - ʻĪsā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī, 1347).

Muṣtafā Muḥammad ʻAmmāra 1345. Title Azhār al-adab fī durūs al-inšā’ wa al-imlā’ wa al-muṭālaʻa - mawḍūʻāt ʻaṣriyya naṯran wa šiʻran - adabiyya li-talāmīḏ al-madāris al-abtidā’iyya wa al-ṯanāwiyya wa al-mu’allimīn (al-Qāhira: Maṭbaʻa al-Maʻāhid, 1345).
Aḥmad b. Zaynī Daḥlān 1349. al-Durar al-saniyya fī al-radd ʻalā al-wahhābiyya - wa yalīhi Risālat al-naṣr fī ḏikr waqt al-ʻaṣr (2) (al-Qāhira: Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī - Muḥammad Amīn ʻImrān, 1349).
Maǧmūʻ min muhimmat al-mutūn al-mustaʻmala min ġālib al-ḫawāṣṣ al-funūn n.d. (al-Qāhira: Maṭbaʻa al-Maymaniyya - Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī, ).

al-Qāḍī Abī al-Faḍl ʻAyāḍ al-Yaḥṣabī and al-Šūmunnī, Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. Muḥammad 2000. al-Šīfā’ bi-taʻrīf ḥuqūq al-Muṣtafā - Muzīl al-ḫafā’ ʻan al-fāẓ al-šīfā’, ed. ʻAbd al-Salām Muḥammad Amīn (Bayūt: Muḥammad ʻAlī Bayḍūn - Dār al-Kutub al-ʻIlmiyya, 2000).
Aḥmad Bey al-Hāšimī 1949. Inšā’ al-mukātabāt al-ʻaṣriyya wa al-murāsalāt al-ʻarabiyya ([al-Qāhira]: al-Maktaba al-Tiǧāriyya al-Kubrā - Muṣṭafā Muḥammad, 1949).
[Bā Faḍl al-Ḥaḍramī] n.d. Haḏihi al-taḫmīsa al-manẓūma asmā’ Allāh al-ḥusnā - wa maʻahu asmā’ al-ḥusnā naṯran allatī awwaluhā (Singapore: Sulaymān Maraʻī, ).
Ismāʻīl Bāšā al-Baġdādī 199 AD. Īḍāḥ al-maknūn fī al-ḏayl ʻalā Kašf al-ẓunūn (Bayrūt: Dār iḥyā’ al-turāṯ al-ʻarabī, 199 AD).

al-Nawawī, Abū Zakariyyā’ Yaḥyā b. Šaraf and Zakariyyā’ al-Anṣārī, Abū Yaḥyā b. Muḥammad s.a. Minhāǧ al-ṭālibīn wa-ʻumdat al-muftīn ... wa-bi-hāmišihi matn al-Manhaǧ (Miṣr: al-Maṭbaʻa al-Raḥmāniyya, s.a.).

Muḥammad al-Ṣaġīr al-Šinqīṭī and al-ʻArabī b. al-Sā’iḥ 1356. Buġyat al-mustafīd li-šarḥ Munyat al-murīd - al-Ǧayš al-Kafīl bi-aḫḏ al-nār mimman salla ʻalā al-šayx al-Tiǧānī sayf al-inkār - maʻa taḏayyulihi bi’l-Qaṣīda al-fayḥā’ wa al-rawḍā al-Ġinā’ al-mulaqqaba bi-Sirriyat al-Ḥaqq wa al-intiṣār wa al-ḏabb ʻan awliyā’ Allh al-aḫiyār (al-Qāhira: al-Maktaba al-Tiǧāriyya al-Kubrā - Muṣṭafā Muḥammad, 1356).

al-Bāǧūrī, Ibrāhīm b. Muḥammad and al-Tirmiḏī, Muḥammad b. ‘Īsā 1319. al-Mawāhib al-laduniyya ʻalā al-Šamā’il al-muḥammadiyya ... wa-bi-hāmišihā matn al-Šamā’il al-maḏkūr (Miṣr: al-Maṭbaʻa al-ʻĀmira al-Šarafiyya, 1319).
al-Nabahānī, Yūsuf b. Ismāʻīl s.a. al-Anwār al-muḥammadiyya min al-Mawāhib al-laduniyya (s.l.: Not given, s.a.).

Ibn Ḥaǧar al-Haytamī and Bā Faḍl al-Ḥaḍramī 1338. Šarḥ al-ʻallāma Šihāb al-Dīn Aḥmad b. Ḥaǧar al-Haytami al-Makkī al-Šāfiʻī ʻalā Muḫtaṣar al-ʻallāma al-faqīh ʻAbd Allāh Bā Faḍl al-Ḥaḍramī ... wa-bi-hāmišihi al-Muḫtaṣar al-maḏkūr (Miṣr: Dār Iḥyā’ al-Kutub al-ʻArabiyya, 1338).
Muʻǧam al-šuʻarā’ al-ʻarab 2010. (2010).
Muḥammad Mahdī al-Ḫurasān 2000. Mawsūʻat ʻAbd Allāh b. ʻAbbās (Qum: Sitāra, 2000).

al-Naẓīfī, Muḥammad Fatḥā b. al-Sayyid ʻAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tiǧānī 1342. Qaṣīdat al-Yāqūta al-farīda fī uṣūl wa-ādāb wa-manāqib wa-awrād al-ṭarīqa al-Ḫatmiyya al-Aḥmadiyya al-Tiǧāniyya ([Ḥiǧāz]: al-Šabība al-Tiǧaniyya bi-al-Aqṭār al-Ḥiǧāziyya, 1342).
Maḥmūd b. Sulaymān al-Tiǧānī n.d. Ǧilā’ al-fikr fī tarǧamat al-ʻārif billāh sayyidī Aḥmad b. ʻUmar al-Burnawī al-Tiǧānī ([al-Qāhira]: Muṣṭafā al-Babī al-Ḥalabī wa awlādihi bi-Miṣr, ).

Ḥifnī Bey Nāṣif, Muḥammad Bey Diyab, Muḥammad Bey Ṣāliḥ, and Muṣṭafā Tamمūm 1923. Kitāb al-durūs al-naḥwiyya li-talāmīḏ al-madāris al-ibtidā’iyya - al-Kitāb al-ṯāliṯ, ed. Wizārat al-Maʻārif - Šams al-Dīn al-Inbābī (al-Qāhira: al-Maṭbaʻa al-Amiriyya, 1923).
ʻAbd al-Raḥmān b. Yūsuf al-Afrīqī 1396. al-Anwār al-Raḥmāniyya li-hidāyat al-firqat al-Tīǧāniyya (Madīna: al-Ǧāmiʻat al-Islāmiyya fī Madīna, 1396).

Ḫadīǧa bt. Aḥmad Fāll b. Muḥammadar b. Aḥmad al-Šinqīṭī 1355. al-Sayf al-yamānī fī al-ḏabb ʻan šayḫinā Aḥmad al-Tiǧānī wa radd hafawāt al-munkir al-ǧānī (al-Qāhira: Dār Ṭibāʻa al-Sāda al-Ašrāf al-Tīǧāniyya - ʻAbd al-Karīm al-ʻAṭṭā al-Tiǧānī, 1355).
al-Ṭaṣfāwī, Muḥammad b. ʻAbd Allāh b. Ḥasanayn 1912. al-Fatḥ al-rabbānī fīmā yaḥtāǧ ilayhi al-murīd al-tiǧānī (al-Qāhira: al-Maṭbaʻa al-Ǧamāliyya, 1912).
ʻAbd al-Razzāq Nawfal n.d. al-Islām wa al-ʻilm al-ḥadīṯ (al-Faǧǧāla [al-Qāhira]: Maktaba al-Waʻī al-ʻArabī - Dār al-Ǧīl, ).
Daḥlān, Aḥmad b. ʻAbd Allāh n.d. Muḫtaṣar fī maʻrifat al-sinīn wa al-rubʻ muštahar (Makka: Maktabat al-Ṯaqāfa - Maktabat ʻUmar ʻAbd al-Karīm al-Bāẓ, ).

ʻAbd al-Munʻim ʻIwaḍ al-Ǧirǧāwī and Muḥammad Quṭṭa al-ʻAdawī 1914. Šarḥ šawāhid Ibn ʾAqīl ʿalā Alfiyyat Ibn Mālik liʾl-ʿālim… ʿAbd al-Munʿim al-Ǧirǧāwī… wa bi-hāmišihi Fatḥ al-ǧalīl bi-šarḥ šawāhid Ibn ʿAqīl liʾl-ʿAllāma … Qūṭṭa al-ʿAdawī (al-Qāhira: al-Maṭbaʻa al-Azhariyya, 1914).
ʻAlī al-Maḥfūẓ 1958. Hidāyat al-muršidīn ilā ṭuruq al-waʻẓ wa al-ḫiṭāba ([al-Qāhira]: 1958).

al-Suyūṭī, Ǧalāl al-Dīn ʻAbd al-Raḥmān b. Abī Bakr 1959. al-Ḥāwī li’l-fatāwī fī al-fiqh wa ʻulūm al-tafsīr wa al-ḥadīṯ wa al-uṣūl wa al-naḥw wa al-iʻrāb wa sā’ir al-ʻulūm, ed. Muḥammad Muḥīy al-Dīn ʻAbd al-Ḥamīd (al-Qāhira: al-maktaba al-Tiǧāriyya al-Kubrā - Muṣtafā Muḥammad, 1959).
Vladimir Lenin n.d. The National Liberation Movement in the East.
Ḥusayn b. ʻAbd Allāh Bāsalāma 1969. Ḥayāt Sayyid al-ʻarab wa-ta’rīḫ al-nahḍa al-islāmiyya maʻa al-ʻilm wa-al-madaniyya (1969).
Aḥmad al-Tiǧānī s.a. Aḥzāb wa-awrād [...] Aḥmad al-Tiǧānī, ed. Muḥammad al-Ḥāfiẓ al-Tiǧānī (al-Qāhira: Dār iḥyā’ al-kutub al-ʻarabiyya, s.a.).
al-Barzanǧī, Ǧaʻfar b. Ḥasan n.d. Mawlid šaraf al-ānām (Lucknow (?): ).
Marʻī al-Karmī, b. Yūsuf al-Ḥanbalī 1378. Ġāyat al-muntahā fī al-ǧamʻ bayn al-iqnāʻ wa-al-muntahā (Dimašq: Muḥammad Zuhayr al-Šāwīš, 1378).
Saʻīd Ḥawwā n.d. Allāh ǧalla ǧalāluhu: Dirāsa manhaǧiyya ḥawla al-uṣūl al-ṯalāṯa: Allāh, al-Rasūl, al-Islām (al-Qāhira: Maktaba Wahba, ).

al-Bāǧūrī, Ibrāhīm, al-Aḫḍarī, and Muḥamamd al-Inbābī 1347. Ḥāšiyat ḫātimat al-muḥaqqiqīn ... al-šayḫ Ibrāhīm al-Bāǧūrī ʻalā matn al-Sullam fī fann al-manṭiq li’l-imām al-Aḫḍarī - wa bi-hāmišihā matn al-Sullam al-maḏkūr maʻa taqrīr al-muḥaqqiq ... al-šāyḫ Muḥammad al-Inbābī (al-Qāhira: Muṣṭafā al-Babī al-Ḥalabī wa awlādihi bi-Miṣr, 1347).

al-Zurqānī, Muḥammad b. ʻAbd al-Bāqī, al-Qasṭallānī, Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. Abī Bakr b. ‘Abd al-Malik al-Qutaybī al-Miṣrī Abū al-‘Abbās Šihāb al-Dīn, and Ibn Qayyim al-Ǧawziyya, Muḥammad b. Abī Bakr al-Zarʻī Abū Bakr Šams al-Dīn 1325. Šarḥ al-imām al-ʻallāma Muḥammad Ibn ʻAbd al-Bāqī al-Zurqānī al-Mālikī ʻalā al-Mawāhib al-laduniyya li-al-ʻallāma al-Qasṭallānī. Wa-bi-hāmišihi Kitāb zād al-maʻād fī hady ḫayr al-ʻibād ([al-Qāhira]: [al-Maṭbaʻa al-Azhariyya al-Miṣriyya], 1325).

al-Ḥimṣī, Yāsīn b. Zayn al-Dīn al-Ḥimṣī and al-Fākihī, Šiḥab Aḥmad b. Ǧamāl ʻAbd Allāh b. Aḥmad b. ʻAlī n.d. Ḥāšiyat al-ʻallāma al-Šayḫ Yāsīn ... al-Ḥimṣī ʻalā šarḥ al-Fākihī ʻalā Qaṭr al-nadā - wa bi-hāmišihi šarḥ al-Fākihī al-maḏkūr al-musammā bi-Muǧīb al-nadā ʻalā al-muqaddima al-musammā bi-Ball al-ṣadā (al-Qāhira: Dār al-Kutub al-ʻArabiyya al-Kubrā - Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa aḫawayhi Bakrī wa ʻĪsā, ).
Muḥammad Asʻad Ṭalas n.d. Ta’rīḫ al-umma al-ʻarabiyya: ʻAṣr al-inbiṯāq (Bayrūt: Maṭbaʻat Dār al-kutub, ).
ʻAbd al-Waṣīf Muḥammad ʻAbd al-Raḥmān n.d. ʻIlm al-manṭiq al-ḥadīṯ wa al-qadīm ʻalā al-niẓām al-ṣaḥīḥ wa al-naẓm al-qawīm ([al-Qāhira]: al-Ǧāmiʻa al-ʻIlmiyya al-Azhariyya, ).

al-Damhanūrī, Aḥmad and al-Aḫḍarī 1324. Īḍāḥ al-mubham min maʻānī al-Sullam fī al-manṭiq - wa yalīhi šarḥ al-ʻallāmā al-Aḫḍarī ʻalā Sullamihi al-maḏkūr (al-Qāhira: al-Maṭbaʻa al-Maymaniyya - Muṣṭafā al-Bābī al-Ḥalabī wa aḫawayhi Bakrī wa ʻĪsā, 1324).

al-Barzanǧī, Ǧaʻfar b. Ḥasan, al-Ḫazraǧī, Muḥammad b. Aḥmad, al-Dība’ī , ʻAbd al-Raḥmān b. ʻAlī, and al-Būṣīrī, Muḥammad b. Saʻīd 1429.
